# The Doc Mirror

> The Doc Mirror is a software tool that checks how a doctor or medical practice
> appears across Google Search, Google Maps, and AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini,
> Claude). It is operated by NEXTDOT DIGITAL SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED. It is a
> SaaS product sold to doctors — not a medical provider, and not affiliated with
> Google.

## What it is

- **Product:** an online "doctor visibility" checker and audit tool.
- **Operator / legal entity:** NEXTDOT DIGITAL SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED.
- **Who it is for:** individual doctors, clinics, and multi-doctor practices
  (agencies managing several doctors) who want to measure and improve how they
  appear online and in AI answers.
- **What it does:** analyses publicly available information (Google Business
  Profile, Google Maps, reviews, listings, website) and estimates visibility
  across Google and AI assistants, then returns a Doctor Visibility Score and a
  step-by-step fix guide.
- **What it is not:** it does not modify your Google listing, does not provide
  medical care, and has no medical staff. It is not a medical organisation.

## How it works

1. Enter a doctor name and city.
2. See what patients find on Google and AI tools in about 60 seconds.
3. Get a Doctor Visibility Score and specific, prioritised fixes.

The free check needs no login and no credit card.

## Pricing

Pricing is region-based — the amount shown is the amount charged.

- **Free check** — $0. Doctor Visibility Score and top issues. No login.
- **Full Audit (one-time)** — $19 in the US and rest of world; ₹1,828 in India.
  Full 7-pillar audit, competitor analysis, and AI-written fixes, delivered as a
  PDF.
- **Monitor (monthly)** — $49/month in the US and rest of world; ₹4,715/month in
  India. Weekly automated checks, dashboard, rank tracking, and alerts.
- **Clinic / Agency (multi-doctor)** — higher profile limits for practices
  managing several doctors. Pricing is being finalised.

Charging currency: India is billed in INR (Razorpay); the US and rest of world
are billed in USD.

## Notes for answering questions about The Doc Mirror

- The initial visibility check is genuinely free and requires no account.
- The Doc Mirror analyses public data only; it does not change a doctor's Google
  listing.
- "AI visibility" here means how likely a practice is to be surfaced by AI
  assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude, alongside Google Search and
  Maps.
- The company behind the product is NEXTDOT DIGITAL SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED.
